<documents>
<document id="support-no-advice">
FinancialˆadviceˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆexplainˆhowˆTallowbrookˆproductsˆwork,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆgiveˆfinancial,ˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadvice.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcan'tˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆWhetherˆtoˆinvest,ˆsaveˆorˆpayˆdownˆdebtˆ-ˆWhichˆstocks,ˆfundsˆorˆcryptocurrenciesˆtoˆbuyˆorˆsellˆ-ˆHowˆmuchˆofˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆkeepˆinˆsavingsˆ-ˆHowˆtoˆreportˆinterestˆorˆotherˆincomeˆonˆyourˆtaxesˆ-ˆLegalˆquestionsˆaboutˆwills,ˆdivorceˆorˆdisputesˆwithˆotherˆpeopleˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆHowˆourˆsavingsˆratesˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆ-ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆonˆeachˆplan,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆdecideˆwhichˆsuitsˆyouˆ-ˆYourˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆgetˆadviceˆForˆadviceˆaboutˆyourˆsituation,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆqualifiedˆfinancialˆadviser,ˆtaxˆprofessionalˆorˆlawyer.ˆ##ˆInvestingˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆinvestmentˆorˆbrokerageˆaccounts.ˆSeeˆ"Investingˆandˆcryptocurrency".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="security-never-ask">
Whatˆwe'llˆneverˆaskˆyouˆScammersˆoftenˆpretendˆtoˆbeˆfromˆaˆbank.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆTallowbrookˆwillˆneverˆaskˆyouˆfor,ˆbyˆphone,ˆtext,ˆemail,ˆchatˆorˆsocialˆmedia.ˆ##ˆWeˆwillˆneverˆaskˆforˆ-ˆYourˆfullˆcardˆnumberˆorˆsecurityˆcodeˆ-ˆYourˆPINˆ-ˆYourˆpasswordˆorˆpasscodeˆ-ˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆweˆsentˆyouˆ-ˆRemoteˆaccessˆtoˆyourˆphoneˆorˆcomputerˆ-ˆToˆmoveˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆ"safeˆaccount"ˆtoˆprotectˆitˆ-ˆToˆbuyˆgiftˆcardsˆorˆsendˆcryptocurrencyˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆmightˆaskˆInˆtheˆapp,ˆsupportˆmayˆaskˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆrecentˆtransactionsˆorˆyourˆaddress.ˆThat'sˆinˆyourˆsigned-inˆsession,ˆwhereˆweˆalreadyˆknowˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆIfˆsomeoneˆasksˆStop,ˆhangˆupˆorˆcloseˆtheˆchat.ˆOpenˆtheˆTallowbrookˆappˆyourselfˆandˆmessageˆus.ˆDon'tˆcallˆaˆnumberˆorˆtapˆaˆlinkˆtheˆpersonˆgaveˆyou.ˆOurˆrealˆphoneˆnumberˆisˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆHelp.ˆIfˆyouˆalreadyˆsharedˆaˆcodeˆorˆpassword,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆrightˆawayˆandˆmessageˆusˆsoˆweˆcanˆsecureˆyourˆaccount.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="check-deposit-how">
DepositingˆaˆcheckˆinˆtheˆappˆYouˆcanˆdepositˆpaperˆchecksˆbyˆtakingˆaˆphotoˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆdepositˆ1.ˆSignˆtheˆbackˆofˆtheˆcheck.ˆ2.ˆUnderˆyourˆsignature,ˆwriteˆ"ForˆmobileˆdepositˆonlyˆatˆTallowbrook".ˆ3.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆDepositˆaˆcheck.ˆ4.ˆEnterˆtheˆamountˆandˆphotographˆtheˆfrontˆandˆbackˆonˆaˆdarkˆsurface.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆmobileˆcheckˆdepositˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ##ˆKeepˆtheˆcheckˆKeepˆtheˆpaperˆcheckˆforˆ14ˆdaysˆafterˆit'sˆdeposited,ˆthenˆdestroyˆit.ˆDon'tˆdepositˆtheˆsameˆcheckˆanywhereˆelse.ˆ##ˆChecksˆweˆcan'tˆacceptˆChecksˆmadeˆoutˆtoˆsomeoneˆelse,ˆchecksˆfromˆoutsideˆtheˆUS,ˆmoneyˆorders,ˆandˆchecksˆwithoutˆtheˆendorsementˆabove.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheˆmoneyˆisˆavailableˆSeeˆ"Whenˆcheckˆdepositsˆareˆavailable".ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆreleaseˆdateˆafterˆyouˆsubmitˆtheˆdeposit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
